This study examines the relationship between HbA1c and hypoglycaemia in type 2 diabetes patients on metformin plus different insulin regimens. While it involves metformin-treated patients and compares different treatment approaches, the outcomes measured are HbA1c, blood glucose levels, and hypoglycaemia episodes. The study does NOT report on lactic acidosis incidence or blood lactate levels, which are the required outcomes for this review.

This randomized trial compares NPL insulin versus insulin glargine added to oral regimens (metformin + sulfonylurea) in type 2 diabetes patients. The primary and secondary outcomes include HbA1c changes, hypoglycemic episodes, fasting glucose, and body weight. There is no mention of lactic acidosis or blood lactate measurements. The study does not address the review's key outcomes.

This randomized controlled trial compares extended-release metformin (MXR) versus immediate-release metformin (MIR) in type 2 diabetes patients. Outcomes measured include HbA1c, BMI, lipid profiles, insulin resistance (HOMA-IR), and islet function (HOMA-B). The study does not assess lactic acidosis incidence or blood lactate levels, which are essential outcomes for this systematic review.

This double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluates adding glipizide GITS to metformin in type 2 diabetes patients. Primary outcomes include A1c and fasting plasma glucose changes. Safety variables were measured but the abstract does not mention lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels. The study focuses on glycemic control rather than the specific adverse outcome of interest for this review.

This post-hoc analysis compares basal-plus-prandial insulin mixtures versus basal insulin glargine in metformin-treated type 2 diabetes patients. Outcomes include glycemic variability indices (standard deviation, coefficient of variation, M-value, mean amplitude of glycemic excursion, J-index) and blood glucose profiles. The study does not report on lactic acidosis or blood lactate levels, which are the required outcomes for this review.
